title: MV Restoring custom window/text after equip change

posts.author: DarkGTX88
posts.body:
Hello,
I am using RPG Maker MV with YEP_X_ChangeBattleEquip to allow players to change their equipment mid-battle.
This plugin is working perfectly as it should.
However, I am also using a common event to draw a custom enemy status window on screen at start of battle. This too is working as intended.
Until...
Entering the equipment change screen, and subsequently exiting: this causes the custom status window and text to disappear and I do not know how to get it back / redraw it, etc.
Here is the common event which draws the custom window and text at the start of battle:
And here is what it looks like in-game:
When the equipment scene is called, it is erased (as desired).
Upon exiting the equipment scene, and returning to battle, the window is gone.
I would like for it to be recreated / redrawn somehow.
My first thought was to simply call the common event again, but I don't know how to do that. I took a look at the YEP_X_ChangeBattleEquip.js file but my Javascript is pretty elementary.
I was thinking something like: $gameTemp.reserveCommonEvent(61);
But I'm not sure if that will work or, more importantly, where to call it within Yanfly's plugin script.
Initially, the common event is being run through another common event, which executes at the start of battle, like so:
If anyone is able to direct me to a simple solution, I would greatly appreciate it. I simply haven't been able to figure it out on my own, using Google, search, etc.
Thank you in advance!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
The trick is that you're actually moving back and forth between two scenes, and MV's editor has no idea how to account or check for that.
You can try this (untested). Open the Change Battle Equip plugin in a text editor. Go to line 142 and create a new line after it. Paste in:
Code:
$gameTemp.reserveCommonEvent(61);
save, refresh the plugin in your plugin manager, save your project, start a new play test.
That should do pretty much what you want, I'm not sure what the closest window the engine will have for running the common event, but it should restore the window you made during the rest of the player's turn.

posts.author: DarkGTX88
posts.body:
I have mostly given up on the idea that this can be accomplished from within the plugin itself. Instead, I am working out a plan to have the plugin set a switch to ON after the equipment scene is opened and subsequently closed during a battle, and then using a parallel process to check to see if that switch is ON.
If the switch is ON, it will run my common event and turn the switch OFF.
Any thoughts on this approach? I will aim to keep this thread updated with results once I can perform a test using a switch and parallel process. I imagine the parallel process is minimal enough to not impact performance but if I am missing a more elegant or minimalist approach, please let me know.
And thank you once again for your help, everyone!
EDIT: Argh! Why do parallel events not seem to work during battle?! *shakes fist angrily at the heavens*

posts.author: DarkGTX88
posts.body:
Well, I have found a workaround that I am satisfied with, at least for the moment.
I found this plugin:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...-yep_x-changebattleequip.113932/#post-1008187
Which causes the character to lose the rest of their turn after changing battle equipment. I am using the version that does NOT allow the user to receive the rest of their turn if they do not change equipment. Instead, the character will end their turn after exiting the equipment screen, even if they decided not to make changes.
For now, I am happy with this solution. Since the equipment screen also allows the player to see the exact breakdown of character stats, I have simply renamed the option in battle to "Stats & Gear," and since this game is heavily influenced by stats—and the player cannot see their stats in battle unless pulling up the equipment screen—it feels at least somewhat justifiable to cost them their turn whether they make changes or not.
Ok, enough over-explaining. Thank you all for the help. Thread can be closed if mods desire.
